baseline.worktree: Inherited dirty research checkout; unrelated changes preserved, new source identities bound in data freeze

authorization: User: Proceed. 0.99 is too strict. I just want the OptionB verbatims to be good.
purpose: A less conservative finite-OptionB demo acceptance policy, not99%-precision qualification or a new acoustic model.

parent.inheritance: Original trained weights/ontology/frontend/train-only normalization unchanged. Original mixed-parent historical gap-fill exposures and unresolved synthetic voice aliases remain disclosed; no clean-lineage or fresh-blind claim.

selection.objective: Maximize pooled HUMAN dev/calibration complete-command micro-F1. Ties prefer minimum split F1, pooled precision, pooled recall, higher probability then higher margin. No99% precision or fixed.99 posterior feasibility constraint. Wrong accepted slots count as both FP and FN; true UNKNOWN/outside-OptionB cases remain negatives, ambiguous references remain unscored.
selection.weights: Only the already-selected original epoch44 model is eligible. No model or optimizer selection in this study.
selection.reuse: Use only hash-bound parent recorded ONNX logits with exact unique human dev/calibration reference membership, class/split agreement and32 finite logits.
selection.exceptions: One global probability/margin gate; UNKNOWN winner still rejects; no per-command thresholds, wording lookup, unsupported-slot coercion or case-specific rescue.

evaluation.mode: Fresh actual-graph original/silence replay after immutable policy lock
evaluation.wording: Report all93 definitions with original human/synthetic test/holdout exact-full-reference wording counts; category/prompt matches are not listened truth
evaluation.negative_reporting: Report every wrong complete command, original UNKNOWN and outside-OptionB false accepts; no negative removal to make verbatim recall look better
evaluation.status: Previously exposed regression evidence, not blind qualification or live actuation

preserve: All old studies/splits/models/policies/labels/source map/private settings stay unchanged. Candidate bundle is separate and non-actuating. No dependency installation, new training, microphone/Pi/device action, commit or push.
